backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister actor for vehicle inspections with types, storage, user profiles, authorization mixins, and inspection management logic.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a migration function that adds a default glassOption field to existing vehicle inspection records.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries linking feature requests to affected frontend files and components with confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all major frontend files for documentation or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables and themes for light and dark modes using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point that loads the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication, profile setup flow, and dashboard rendering with fallback states.
frontend/src/components/CameraCaptureDia: Camera capture modal that manages camera permissions, device selection, quality settings, and outputs photos as ExternalBlob objects.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/FormalReportView: Displays a full printable inspection report, supports editing letterhead info for admins, and provides PDF/print/export actions.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the app header with authentication controls and shows the logged‑in user’s profile info.
frontend/src/components/InspectionDetail: Shows detailed inspection data, allows insurance officers to approve/reject reports, and opens the formal report view.
frontend/src/components/InspectionForm.t: Form for inspectors to submit a new vehicle inspection report, including uploading photos and validation.
Displays a grid of inspection cards with status and metadata, enabling selection to view detailed information.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and role to create a profile.
frontend/src/components/ReviewQueue.tsx: Displays pending vehicle inspections for review with loading states and a dialog for detailed inspection viewing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login handling, and identity persistence through a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for profiles, inspections, reviews, and letterhead info.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, CSS variables for light/dark themes, and print-specific rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Shows user dashboard with tabs for reports, inspection creation, and review queue depending on role and admin status.
frontend/src/utils/cameraSettings.ts: Manages camera preference storage and retrieval plus predefined quality configurations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing parameters from hash-based routes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project state including existing features, pending feature requests, metadata, and version info.
